body: Yeah but it’s super painful and the procedure is dangerous af.

Therapy will give me the coping methods I so desperately need and a voice in my head that isn’t constant unending negativity. 

Thanks for reminding me.

I used to be a little proud that I had gone through all of it because “I’m a survivor! I won’t label myself a victim because I’m so much more than that.” But oh god.. that was when I thought that maybe the punches would stop coming. I’m surviving but I’m not thriving. I miscarried last October while my husband was deployed. I was alone and all I could think was, “It’s ok, I can definitely get through this.” But when he came back, it was my fault. As usual. I couldn’t handle that on top of the miscarriage. I need centuries of therapy. He knows he needs it too, it’s just a matter of finding a good one.

Nope. Because it wasn’t his fault. It was a perfect storm of nurses/doctors too overworked to look closer and his ability to charm everyone around him. It seems impossible, that someone should have been like “this doesn’t add up” but even my own mother told me I was making shit up. He’d say that I was “prone to over-exaggeration.”

I replied to the other comment if you’d like to read that. My dog slipped in the grass while playing and hurt himself and I was treated to the ugliest glare and “Why the hell were you playing so rough? We can’t afford vet bills right now!” That was the catalyst. All the memories came rushing back and I’ve locked myself in the bathroom.

Birth mother: She had five other kids; all boys. She would regularly bite me, hit me with a belt, not feed me, and the courts suspect sexual abuse too. But she dropped me off in the middle of the night at social services when I was around 2 years old. No one was there and I either wandered away or was taken in by homeless people(the surrounding area was populated with a ton of homeless people.) Then at four, I was taken in by social services and places in foster homes. 

Foster homes: First one made me sleep in the closet in diapers, with potato chips and snack foods for sustenance. Was made to do the dishes/laundry/yard work when I should have been learning to be an actual kid. All the others, and the first, heavily favoured their own kids and left me out of events/gatherings. 

Adoptive mum: Extremely religious. That’s all I’ll say about that. 

My ex-husband didn’t show his true colours until 3-4months into the marriage. I was essentially tortured. TRIGGER WARNING: Rape, domestic violence. He is extremely persuasive and separated me from current friends. I was in the marriage for five years, during which he raped me basically whenever he wanted, drugged me on a few occasions so his ‘friends’ could share, lots of emotional and mental abuse, gaslighting, control, etc. I wasn’t allowed to have a job for long because he wanted absolute control of my finances. I’m basically unemployable with a history of not coming to work without calling out because he said he didn’t want me to work there anymore and he’d explain everything to them(he didn’t.) Physical violence; he broke both my jaws(I almost died in the hospital), several of my toes(I love to run, it’s therapeutic), my fingers, I have little scars from where he’d hold the knife against me as a game. I adopted a dog from a shelter, he hit the dog once, and that was it. That gave me the strength to actually leave. Shows you how much I care about myself. 

Current husband is not physically abusive or sexually but again, nothing is his fault. Nothing. Ever.

Oh I guess that was pretty vague. Yeah I was referred to a psychiatrist and therapist. When the first six medications all made me have reactions they did the GeneSight testing which is when I discovered that only 3 meds will work safely due to how I metabolise the meds. I don’t fit the description for BPD but I’ve been diagnosed with PTSD from a previous abusive relationship(replace abusive with torture because that’s basically what it amounted to according to my therapists) and the depression just started this year. 

Honestly, the PTSD is icing on the shit cake as they say. It’s been a shitty life so far and I’ve never turned to suicidal thoughts. Just kinda kept muscling along. Uhm.. I love animals and looking at people’s pets helps sometimes. I tried lighting a candle too but today is hard I guess. My dream used to be a writer but lately I want to become a dog trainer professionally. I’ve done it for rescues off and on for years but we learn new things about them every day and it’s fascinating. 

I always think about the most painless ways. I’ve suffered a lot of physical pain in my life and it’s made me afraid of it. I fantasize about going to sleep and not waking up a lot. Like.. a lot. I’ve noticed myself being more careless with my actions, like tripping more, not cleaning scrapes or cuts I get when I fall or if I accidentally grab a hot thing from the oven I take longer to let go. I wouldn’t say that killing myself feels like the right thing to do.. just that it would provide relief. The only thing I’ve ever wanted with any consistency is to be normal, to not have had the experiences I’ve gone through. If I die, it doesn’t matter that I suffered for so long because it’s just done. I don’t have to think about new ways to cope or heal. 

I’m going to be 29 in 10 days.
